1.title: Exam Orientation and How to Study
1.text: Welcome to Module zero: Exam Orientation and How to Study. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do seven things. What the exam is. The four skill areas. Where each area lives in this course. How to read the exam wording. A repeatable way to answer. A study plan. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Scope: All four skill areas. Exam format: forty-five minutes; a score of seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand passes. Validated against: the official S C nine hundred study guide, skills measured as of October twenty-one, two thousand twenty-six.

1.title: What the exam is
1.text: What the exam is. S C nine hundred (Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals) is a beginner-level exam. It is for business stakeholders, new or existing I T professionals and students who want to understand the fundamentals of security, compliance and identity across Microsoft Azure and Microsoft three sixty-five. You must describe what each Microsoft solution does and pick the right one for a short scenario. You do not need to configure anything.

1.title: What the exam is, continued
1.text: What the exam is. Time. forty-five minutes. Passing score. seven hundred or more, on a scale of one to one thousand. Retake. twenty-four hours after the first attempt; later waits vary. Format. Proctored; may include interactive components. Languages. English first; other languages about eight weeks later. Number of questions, price. not on the pages this course was built from: confirm on the exam page. The price depends on the country or region. Note. A score of seven hundred is not seventy percent. Do not compute a percentage; aim to understand every skill in the study guide.

1.title: What the exam is, continued
1.text: What the exam is. The figure shows this: The S C nine hundred exam at a glance: four skill areas and their weights.

1.title: The four skill areas
1.text: The four skill areas. Concepts of security, compliance and identity. Weight: ten to fifteen percent. What it asks: Zero Trust, defense in depth, encryption, G R C, authentication and authorization. Capabilities of Microsoft Entra. Weight: twenty-five to thirty percent. What it asks: Identity types, M F A, Conditional Access, roles, governance, protection. Capabilities of Microsoft security solutions. Weight: thirty-five to forty percent. What it asks: Azure network security, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Defender X D R.

1.title: The four skill areas, continued
1.text: The four skill areas. Capabilities of Microsoft compliance solutions. Weight: twenty to twenty-five percent. What it asks: Service Trust Portal, Purview, labels, D L P, retention, insider risk, e discovery, audit.

1.title: The four skill areas, continued
1.text: The four skill areas. Security solutions is the biggest area. Most questions ask which product does what, so learn each product with its one-line purpose. Exam tip: Microsoft renamed many products. Questions may use old or new names: Azure Active Directory is Microsoft Entra I D; Microsoft three sixty-five Defender is Microsoft Defender X D R; Azure A D Identity Protection is Microsoft Entra I D Protection; Microsoft Cloud App Security is Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps.

1.title: Where each area lives in this course
1.text: Where each area lives in this course. one, two. Concepts of security, compliance and identity. three, four, five, six. Microsoft Entra. seven, eight, nine, ten. Microsoft security solutions. eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen. Microsoft compliance solutions. fifteen. All: exam technique and final review.

1.title: How to read the exam wording
1.text: How to read the exam wording. Describe. Explain what it is and what it is for. Define. Give the meaning in one sentence. Identify the capability. Pick the product or feature that fits a need.

1.title: A repeatable way to answer
1.text: A repeatable way to answer. Read the last sentence first: what is asked? Find the key need: sign-in, access rules, threats on email, data labels, audit. Name the product family: Entra (identity), Defender (threats), Sentinel (sim), Purview (data and compliance). Remove products from other families. Choose the most specific match. Mark and move on if unsure after a minute. Exam tip: Four families answer most questions: Entra controls who gets in; Defender stops and detects threats; Sentinel collects and analyzes security events; Purview protects data and manages compliance.

1.title: A study plan
1.text: A study plan. one. What to do: Concepts: security, compliance and identity. Modules: one to two. two. What to do: Microsoft Entra. Modules: three to six. three. What to do: Security solutions. Modules: seven to ten. four. What to do: Compliance solutions. Modules: eleven to fourteen. five. What to do: Review with the cards and practice questions. Modules: fifteen. Spaced review: answer each module's recall questions from memory, then check; repeat the Quick Reference Card the next day and after a week.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. Fabrikam Outdoors asks which skill area has the largest weight in S C nine hundred. Which is it? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Capabilities of Microsoft security solutions. Microsoft security solutions is thirty-five to forty percent, the largest. Entra is twenty-five to thirty percent, compliance twenty to twenty-five percent and concepts ten to fifteen percent.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. A candidate scores seven hundred. What does this mean? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: The candidate reached the passing score on a scale of one to one thousand. seven hundred or more on a scale of one to one thousand passes. It is not a percentage.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. A question uses the name "Azure Active Directory". Which product does it mean? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Microsoft Entra I D. Azure Active Directory was renamed Microsoft Entra I D.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. A question asks which family protects data with labels and manages compliance. Which family is it? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Microsoft Purview. Purview covers data protection, governance and compliance.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. How long is S C nine hundred, and what score passes? Answer: forty-five minutes; seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand. Question two. Name the four skill areas. Answer: Concepts; Microsoft Entra; Microsoft security solutions; Microsoft compliance solutions. Question three. Which area has the largest weight? Answer: Microsoft security solutions (thirty-five to forty percent).

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. What was Azure Active Directory renamed? Answer: Microsoft Entra I D. Question five. Which part of a question do you read first? Answer: The last sentence. Question six. Which family manages data and compliance? Answer: Microsoft Purview.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Format: forty-five minutes; pass at seven hundred of one thousand; proctored; retake after twenty-four hours. Areas: concepts ten to fifteen percent, Entra twenty-five to thirty percent, security solutions thirty-five to forty percent, compliance twenty to twenty-five percent. Families: Entra equals who; Defender equals threats; Sentinel equals events (sim); Purview equals data and compliance. Old names: Azure A D equals Entra I D; Microsoft three sixty-five Defender equals Defender X D R. In the next module, we continue the course.
